mintAuthority.summary: USDF uses AccessControl; MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE (0x144dc672...) is held by the USDFEarn UUPS proxy (0xc271fc70...) which mints USDF 1:1 on USDT deposit. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x0) is held by a 6h OZ TimelockController whose PROPOSER_ROLE includes a 4-of-8 Gnosis Safe.

controls.label: USDFEarn contract (MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE holder)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103622485: hasRole(MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE=0x144dc672..., 0xc271fc70...) on USDF token returned true. eth_getCode returned CONTRACT (len=1712). EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x000...9be60400d043864a99a8fe1be479c9eb299198c1 (UUPS proxy). Confirmed by Transfer(from=0x0, to=AstherusVault) events in USDF minting txs; AstherusVault source shows depositUSDF() calls USDF_EARN.deposit() which internally mints.

controls.label: USDF DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (OZ TimelockController, 6h delay)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103622485: eth_getCode = CONTRACT (len=15848). getMinDelay() = 21600 (6h). hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=0x0, this_address) on USDF = true. getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0) on timelock = itself (self-administered). PROPOSER_ROLE count = 2: [4-of-8 Safe 0xa8c0c6ee..., timelock itself]. getRoleAdmin(MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE) = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, confirming timelock governs minter grants.

controls.label: Astherus governance multisig (Timelock PROPOSER, 4/8 Safe)
